469: def evaluate_period(
470:     price: np.ndarray,
471:     g_pre: np.ndarray,
472:     P: SimpleNamespace,
473:     b_grid: np.ndarray,
474:     shared: SimpleNamespace,
475:     counter: SolveCounter,
476:     supply_rule: HousingSupplyRule | None = None,
477:     supplied_policy: PolicyBundle | None = None,
478: ) -> PeriodEvaluation:
479:     policy = supplied_policy or solve_policy(price, P, b_grid, shared, counter)
480:     if not np.array_equal(np.asarray(price).reshape(-1), policy.price):
481:         raise ValueError("Supplied policy price does not match the requested price")
482:     gated, projected_mass = gate_pre_fertility_distribution(g_pre, policy, P, b_grid, shared)
483:     if joint_nested_enabled(P):
484:         g_post, effective_tenure, birth_matrix, _, _ = factor_joint_distribution(
485:             gated, policy, P
486:         )
487:         policy = replace(policy, tenure_probs=effective_tenure)
488:         births = float(np.sum(birth_matrix))
489:         if int(P.I) != 1:
490:             raise NotImplementedError("Joint-nested dated evaluation currently requires one market")
491:         births_by_loc = np.array([births], dtype=float)
492:     else:
493:         continuation = policy_continuation_birth_probs(policy, P)
494:         g_post, births, births_by_loc = apply_fertility(
495:             gated, policy.fert_probs, P, continuation
496:         )
497:     g_current = model.realize_current_cross_section(
498:         g_post,
499:         policy.loc_probs,
500:         policy.tenure_choice,
501:         policy.tenure_probs,
502:         policy.maps.lmm_idx,
503:         policy.maps.lmm_wt,
504:         policy.maps.tmx_idx,
505:         policy.maps.tmx_wt,
506:         use_compiled_scatter=bool(getattr(P, "use_numba_scatter", False)),
507:     )
508:     demand = housing_demand_by_location(g_current, policy.hR_pol, P)
509:     supply = (
510:         supply_rule.quantity(policy.price)
511:         if supply_rule is not None
512:         else P.H0 * ((P.user_cost_rate * policy.price) / P.r_bar) ** P.xi_supply
513:     )
514:     residual = float(np.max(np.abs(demand - supply) / np.maximum(supply, 1e-12)))
515:     return PeriodEvaluation(
516:         policy,
517:         gated,
518:         g_post,
519:         g_current,
520:         births,
521:         births_by_loc,
522:         demand,
523:         supply,
524:         residual,
525:         projected_mass,
526:         inherited_g_pre=g_pre.copy() if joint_nested_enabled(P) else None,
527:     )
